newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * The National Peasant Party (PNTCD) and the Social Democratic Union (USD) held talks on power-sharing in the new government. President-elect Emil Constantinescu and USD leader Petre Roman attended.

* Constantinescu said that parties in the ruling coalition would meet by the end of the week to appoint the prime minister and the cabinet. He said he abides by previous promises that Romania would have a new government by December 1.
Constantinescu also said that parties would meet to draft a political accord on supporting the government and that he expected the text of the accord to be released on Saturday.
* The USD got six government portfolios, under accord before the presidential run-offs, Petre Roman said, naming foreign affairs, defence, transport, communications, labour and environment.
* President Ion Iliescu called a news conference on Tuesday at the end of his term.
* Iliescu met heads of diplomatic missions in Romania on Monday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
